Coverage_Description: Basic off-campus dental package: scaling/polishing once; unlimited dental examinations, intra-oral small film radiographs (when dentist-required), and emergency abscess drainage plus 3-day pain/infection medication
pricing: HK$240/year (HKBU/HKBU-SCE students except part-time self-funded); HK$320/year (HKBU/HKBU-SCE part-time self-funded).
customer requirement: HKBU/HKBU-SCE student eligibility; voluntary enrolment via online form or HKBU app
price structure: Annual flat fee by student category; other dental services charged separately
additional informations: benefits period: 1 Oct 2025-31 Aug 2026; appointments must be booked in advance via UMP hotline/WhatsApp (scheduling through 31 Jul 2026)
